name: Transform the Salesforce — Thornbury's Digital Mandate
description: A four-round, advanced commercial-transformation simulation set inside Thornbury Industrial Supplies Ltd., a £148M UK B2B distributor of MRO products in Coventry. Its commercial engine is a 95-rep field sales force on a paper-and-spreadsheet pipeline, with a website that takes just 11% of orders. On 6 March 2026 the three largest accounts (£19M, 13% of revenue) issue a joint digital-procurement mandate: from 1 October 2026 they will only buy from suppliers offering punch-out catalogues, real-time stock/ETA, self-service reordering and API e-procurement integration — none of which Thornbury can do today. With another ~£22M of mid-market accounts watching, ~28% of revenue is exposed. The board approves a £4.5M, 18-month transformation budget, but full scope across all four levers costs ~£7.8M (1.7× budget), so sequencing under a binding constraint is the whole game. Playing the new Commercial Director, you (1) DIAGNOSE the operating model — read where value is created vs where cost-to-serve is highest, segment accounts by digital-readiness and strategic value, and name the most exposed segments; (2) PLAN the 18-month roadmap, allocating the £4.5M across commerce platform/e-procurement, CRM & analytics, rep reskilling & change, and inside-sales/digital channel — the mandate forces platform-first, but skipping reskilling strands the technology; (3) DECIDE the coverage model, the reskilling plan, the redesigned commission, and a channel-conflict governance rule under a facilitator-played rep council; and (4) RECOVER & PROVE ROI to the CFO with revenue retained, cost-to-serve change and payback on the £4.5M. The math rewards platform-first with funded reskilling, value-based coverage (keep complex accounts field-led), channel-neutral commission, and pricing governance — and punishes the five classic errors: technology-first/people-later (£2.4M platform nobody uses), digitising the strategic accounts that most need a human, leaving a commission plan that pays reps to keep reorders off the portal, opening a marketplace without pricing governance, and reporting activity instead of value. Final KPIs track Retained Revenue (£M), Digital Adoption %, Rep Capability, and Channel-Conflict & Margin Risk.
view:
6 March 2026 · Thornbury Industrial Supplies · Coventry · Mandate takes effect 1 October

Transform the Salesforce

You are the new Commercial Director of a £148M B2B distributor whose three biggest accounts have issued a digital-procurement mandate you cannot meet today. You have £4.5M against £7.8M of full scope, 95 field reps, and four rounds before the finance director asks what the money bought.

Round 1 of 4 Mandate live · 1 Oct deadline
Retained Revenue
£0.0M
Exposed revenue defended · ~£41M at risk
Digital Adoption
11%
Share of orders self-served (start 11%)
Rep Capability
19
Digitally-confident, enabled reps (0–100)
Channel & Margin Risk
55
Channel conflict & price erosion (lower better)
Transformation budget committed £0.0M / £4.5M
🔧
Round 1 — Diagnose the commercial operating model

Your Decisions This Round

Deadline treated as hard: 50%
Commerce platform & e-procurement — punch-out, API, stock/ETA (meets the mandate)
CRM & sales analytics — replace the paper-and-spreadsheet pipeline
Rep reskilling & change program — turn 18 of 95 confident reps into many more
Inside-sales / digital channel build — the low-cost reorder route
Budget allocated: 4.5 / £4.5M
Redeployment & coaching investment: 50%
Facilitator (the field-rep council & the CFO)
Two voices will challenge you all the way: the field-rep council that owns the relationships and 55% of their pay in reorder commission, and a CFO who approved £4.5M and wants revenue retained, cost-to-serve and payback — not "platform delivered." The mandate is a leadership and sequencing problem, not a software purchase: buy the platform but skip the people and adoption stalls at 9%; digitise the wrong accounts and you break the ones that most need a human; open a channel without a pricing rule and you start a price war with yourself.

Round-by-Round Record

Adoption, Capability & Channel-Risk Trajectory

text.en: Design the sequence of a customer-mandated commercial transformation under a binding budget and a hard external deadline, and defend what is deferred
text.es: Diseñar la secuencia de una transformación comercial exigida por los clientes con un presupuesto vinculante y un plazo externo inamovible, y defender lo que se aplaza
text.pt: Desenhar a sequência de uma transformação comercial exigida pelo cliente, com orçamento restritivo e prazo externo rígido, e defender o que fica para depois

text.en: Apply customer value and cost to serve to allocate accounts to selling routes, rather than relying on cost alone or on rep preference
text.es: Aplicar el valor del cliente y el coste de servirlo para asignar cuentas a canales de venta, en lugar de basarse solo en el coste o en la preferencia de los comerciales
text.pt: Aplicar valor do cliente e custo de servir para alocar contas às rotas de venda, em vez de depender só do custo ou da preferência do vendedor

text.en: Redesign sales compensation and channel pricing governance so that the incentive plan and the price list stop working against the change
text.es: Rediseñar la retribución comercial y la gobernanza de precios por canal para que el plan de incentivos y la lista de precios dejen de ir en contra del cambio
text.pt: Redesenhar a remuneração de vendas e a governança de preços por canal para que o plano de incentivos e a tabela de preços deixem de trabalhar contra a mudança

text.en: Justify a transformation in the finance function's terms of revenue retained, cost-to-serve movement and payback, and act decisively on a single named account against a deadline
text.es: Justificar una transformación en los términos de la función financiera, es decir, ingresos retenidos, variación del coste de servicio y plazo de recuperación, y actuar con decisión sobre una cuenta concreta ante un plazo
text.pt: Justificar uma transformação nos termos da área financeira — receita retida, variação do custo de servir e payback — e agir com decisão sobre uma conta específica diante de um prazo

name.en: Buying the platform and leaving the people for later
name.es: Comprar la plataforma y dejar a las personas para después
name.pt: Comprar a plataforma e deixar as pessoas para depois

lure.en: The mandate lists technical requirements with a date, so the platform looks like the whole job and training can follow once the tools exist.
lure.es: El mandato enumera requisitos técnicos con una fecha, así que la plataforma parece todo el trabajo y la formación puede venir cuando existan las herramientas.
lure.pt: O mandato lista requisitos técnicos com uma data, então a plataforma parece ser o trabalho inteiro e o treinamento pode vir quando as ferramentas existirem.

consequence.en: The platform goes live and nobody sells through it: adoption and capability drop, retained revenue falls and the run is marked Platform Stranded.
consequence.es: La plataforma se pone en marcha y nadie vende con ella: caen la adopción y la capacidad, bajan los ingresos retenidos y la partida queda como Plataforma Varada.
consequence.pt: A plataforma entra no ar e ninguém vende por ela: adoção e capacidade caem, a receita retida diminui e a partida fica como Plataforma encalhada.

source.ref: TN MKT-2026-1947 §5.1, §9.1 TN-Exhibits 5 and 6 (the Round 2 cliff) and §13

name.en: Moving every account to digital because adoption is the visible number
name.es: Pasar todas las cuentas a digital porque la adopción es la cifra visible
name.pt: Levar todas as contas para o digital porque a adoção é o número visível

lure.en: The signatories asked for self-service, and moving everyone produces the highest adoption reading on the screen.
lure.es: Las firmantes pidieron autoservicio, y mover a todas produce la lectura de adopción más alta de la pantalla.
lure.pt: As signatárias pediram autoatendimento, e mover todas produz a leitura de adoção mais alta da tela.

consequence.en: Retained revenue falls and channel risk rises: the complex, high-value accounts lose the person who managed them.
consequence.es: Caen los ingresos retenidos y sube el riesgo de canal: las cuentas complejas y de alto valor pierden a la persona que las gestionaba.
consequence.pt: A receita retida cai e o risco de canal sobe: as contas complexas e de alto valor perdem a pessoa que cuidava delas.

pt: todas as contas para o digital

source.ref: TN MKT-2026-1947 §5.2 and §13 (confusing adoption with success)

name.en: Launching self-service with the commission plan unchanged
name.es: Lanzar el autoservicio sin tocar el plan de comisiones
name.pt: Lançar o autoatendimento sem mexer no plano de comissões

lure.en: Nobody wants a pay dispute in the middle of a roll-out, and the plan has worked for years.
lure.es: Nadie quiere una disputa salarial en plena implantación, y el plan ha funcionado durante años.
lure.pt: Ninguém quer uma disputa de remuneração no meio da implantação, e o plano funcionou por anos.

consequence.en: Reps are paid to keep reorders off the portal: adoption falls and channel risk rises in the same round.
consequence.es: A los comerciales se les paga por mantener las recompras fuera del portal: la adopción cae y el riesgo de canal sube en la misma ronda.
consequence.pt: Os vendedores são pagos para manter as recompras fora do portal: a adoção cai e o risco de canal sobe na mesma rodada.

source.ref: TN MKT-2026-1947 §5.4, §7 Q3 and §13 (blaming the resistant 41)

name.en: Opening the marketplace at a discount before agreeing a price floor
name.es: Abrir el marketplace con descuento antes de acordar un suelo de precio
name.pt: Abrir o marketplace com desconto antes de acordar um piso de preço

lure.en: List price minus 8% wins volume fast, and the floor can be set once the channel is running.
lure.es: El precio de lista menos 8% gana volumen rápido, y el suelo puede fijarse cuando el canal ya funcione.
lure.pt: Preço de tabela menos 8% ganha volume rápido, e o piso pode ser definido quando o canal já estiver rodando.

consequence.en: The largest field-managed accounts find the listing and demand the same discount: retained revenue falls, channel risk jumps and the run is marked Price War With Yourself.
consequence.es: Las mayores cuentas de campo encuentran el listado y exigen el mismo descuento: caen los ingresos retenidos, se dispara el riesgo de canal y la partida queda como Guerra de Precios Contra Ti Mismo.
consequence.pt: As maiores contas atendidas pelo campo encontram o anúncio e exigem o mesmo desconto: a receita retida cai, o risco de canal dispara e a partida fica como Guerra de preços contra si mesmo.

pt: guerra de preços contra si mesmo

name.en: Leaving the wavering anchor account to the next wave
name.es: Dejar la cuenta ancla que vacila para la siguiente ola
name.pt: Deixar a conta-âncora que vacila para a próxima onda

lure.en: The integration is already planned, special treatment for one customer feels unfair, and rushing risks a bad launch.
lure.es: La integración ya está planificada, el trato especial a un cliente parece injusto y precipitarse arriesga un mal lanzamiento.
lure.pt: A integração já está planejada, tratamento especial para um cliente parece injusto, e apressar é arriscar um lançamento ruim.

consequence.en: The £9M account triggers its switching clause: retained revenue falls sharply and the run is marked Anchor Account Lost.
consequence.es: La cuenta de 9 M£ activa su cláusula de cambio: los ingresos retenidos caen con fuerza y la partida queda como Cuenta Ancla Perdida.
consequence.pt: A conta de £ 9 mi aciona a cláusula de troca de fornecedor: a receita retida cai forte e a partida fica como Conta-âncora perdida.
